quiz.title: BONFIRE NIGHT EDITION
quiz.greeting: Remember, remember! Twelve sparkling questions await. Press red to begin.
quiz.share: I scored {score}/12 on Flummox!, the Teletext quiz on STEEVEFAX page 152. Can you flummox Felix?

verdicts.text: Felix is utterly FLUMMOXED! A perfect game.
Not bad. Felix has seen worse.
Felix is not flummoxed in the slightest.

questions.question: In which year was the Gunpowder Plot?
questions.quip: Right! And we've lit bonfires ever since.

questions.question: Remember, remember the fifth of November: gunpowder, treason and what?
Guy Fawkes was caught with the gunpowder under which building?
questions.quip: Right! In a cellar, just before midnight.

questions.question: Which metal gives fireworks a green colour?
questions.quip: Correct! Strontium makes red, copper makes blue.

questions.question: Which ITV Teletext service took over from ORACLE in 1993?
questions.quip: Right! It ran on ITV until 2009.

questions.question: Where is the Up Helly Aa fire festival held?
questions.quip: Right! In Shetland, where they burn a Viking longship.

questions.question: Which ginger cake is a Bonfire Night favourite in Yorkshire?
questions.quip: Yes! Best left a few days to get sticky.

questions.question: Which 1982 Sinclair home computer had rubber keys?
In Minecraft, which green mob hisses, then explodes?
Which programming language is named after a comedy group?
questions.quip: Correct! Monty Python, not the snake.
